overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Reserve Edition 6-Person Near Zero EMF Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna with Himalayan Salt Bar offers a luxurious and health-focused retreat in the comfort of your home. Designed for ultimate relaxation and wellness, this sauna combines 9 advanced heaters, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR IR Carbon Panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it features an oversize interior chromotherapy lighting system and red light therapy for enhanced therapeutic benefits. Ideal for indoor spaces like basements or fitness rooms, this sauna also includes Bluetooth connectivity and built-in speakers, ensuring a personalized, spa-like experience every time.
